pages.title: Bibblino Scrollino
pages.content:
# Bibblino Scrollino

The Bible, but it scrolls. Named after our mascot: a leather-bound Bible in sneakers who can't stop doomscrolling the Word.

An endless, swipeable feed of Bible verses from all 66 books.

- **For You**: a mix of well-loved passages and deep cuts from every corner of scripture
- **Books**: binge any book in order, shuffle it, or read it chapter by chapter
- **🤌 Brainrot Bible**: absurd characters shout an Italian chant, then the real verse hits, with pop-up captions; export any card as a video
- **Themes**: endless scroll on love, anxiety, strength, hope, wisdom, and more

Bibblino Scrollino needs JavaScript to run. See [About](/about) for details on the translation.

pages.title: About
pages.content:
# About Bibblino Scrollino

Bibblino Scrollino turns the whole Bible into an infinite feed. Swipe to see passages from all 66 books, double-tap to like, and tap through to read any passage in context or binge a book from start to finish.

## Translation

Scripture text is the **Berean Standard Bible (BSB)**, which has been dedicated to the public domain. Learn more at [berean.bible](https://berean.bible).

## Narration

Video cards use the Berean Standard Bible audio narration read by Bob Souer, which has been dedicated to the public domain. Captions are synced word-by-word, so every video works with the sound off.

## Brainrot Bible

The 🤌 feed introduces Bible stories with absurd characters in the style of Italian brainrot memes. The character art is AI-generated and the Italian chants use a text-to-speech voice. The verse that follows is always the exact Berean Standard Bible text, read by a human narrator.

## Your data

Likes, streaks, and reading progress are stored only in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
